Uddhatavṛkodaraprekṣaṇaka
play. by Bhāgavata Kṛṣṇappa. Mysore I. p. 274. Skt. Col.. Mys. p. 5 (a., Kṛṣṇa Śarmā).

Uddhatāvṛtti_(?)
--C. on Anekārthasaṅgraha. lex. Ānandāśrama 766.

Uddharaṇa
father of Anantasena an. grandfather of Śivadāsasena (a. of Tattvacandrikā, C. on Cakradattacikitsāsaṅgraha, BBRAS. 173; Dravyaguṇasaṅgrahaṭīkā, L. 1630. 2932).

Uddharaṇa
King; father of Śaṁtanu of the Tomara line. (Caṇḍīmāhātmyaṭīkā). See Venk. Press, edn. of text with 7 C.s., Bombay 1916.

Uddharaṇa
--son of Lakṣmīdharasena an. grandfather of Śivadāsasena Yaśodhara (Tattvacandrikā, C. on Cakrapāṇidatta's Saṅgraha, med.). IO. 2676.

Uddharaṇakathā
Jain. Apabhraṁśa. Ms. in a Jain temple a. Jasvantnagar (U. P.). See Allahabad Uni. Studies I (1925), 181.

Uddharaṇakālātikramaprāyaścitta
Burnell 27b. 149b. Hz. 1899. TD. 13064-77.

Uddhava
one of the poets whose verses are found in Hāla's Saptaśatī (III. 57). [Page338-b]

Uddhava
father of Ananta Dvivedī or A. Deva (a. of Bhojanasūtra, Bomb. Uni. I. 932; Rudrasūtra, Mithilā IV. 142 etc.).

Uddhava
--C. on Nirṇayatattva of Nāgadaivajña. Ujjain Latest Additions 239.

Uddhavagītā
Lord's teachings to Uddhava in Bk. XI of the Bhāgavata, chs. 7-29.
Pt.. with analysis, translation, an. C. in Bengali. Calcutta, 1900. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 492. 714.

Uddhavacamatkārakāvya
with C. in illustration of metrics. in 4 cantos. by Jagaddurlabha. Viśvabhāratī 801. 802.

Uddhavacarita
kāvya. by Raghunandanadāsa. IO. 3894.

Uddhavadāsa(vaiṣṇava)
pupil of Rāghavadāsa, a pupil (?) of Śrīnivāsācārya.
--Saṁskṛtamañjarī. Bomb. Uni. 169. BORI. 814 of 1886-92.

Uddhavadūta
or u. sandeza identity not known. Cuttack 142 (with C.). Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 12. SSPC. II. C. 73 (inc.). Sūcīpattra 92.
--C. Cuttack 142. Dacca 542. M. M. (inc.).

Uddhavadūta
kāvya (in 141 v..). by Mādhava Kavīndra, son of Kaviśekhara of Tālitapura near Vardhamāna in Rāḍha; an. born in the family of Kavicandra who lived a. Pūrṇapura near Burdwan.
Alwar 894. C.. VI. 8. 9. Dacca 298C. 2439. MD. 11829 (in 141 v..). PUL. [Page339-a. II. p. 250 (3 mss.) (Uddhavasandeśa). RASB. VII. 5182. SK. Ray 286 (inc.). SSPC. II. C. 142 (inc.). 154. III. E. 16. Stein 66. Vaṅgīya p. 187. Viśvabhāratī 732. 809 (d. Śaka 1742).
Pt.. (1) in Haeberlin p.. 348-73. (2) Jīvānanda Vidyāsāgara, Kāvyasaṅgraha 3rd edn. Pt. I. p.. 531-595. Calcutta. (3) Kāvyakalāpa, Bombay 1864.
--C. Viśvabhāratī 733.

Uddhavadūta
kāvya. with C. 85 verses. Composed in 1832 A. D. by Rājavallabhamiśra. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1897-1901, p. 45 (no. 143). Published by Pandit Nṛsiṁhadatta under the order of H. H. the Maharaja of Benares (1881, Benares). See also ‘A new Uddhavadūta by Baladeva Upādhyāya’, IHQ. 1936. Vol. 12. p.. 104-108.

Uddhavadūta
or uddhavasandeza kāvya. in 138 stanzas (131 in some). by Rūpagosvāmin.
Dacca 70D (inc.). 3522. Filliozat I. 198 (p. 9). (U. S. prabandha) Hpr. I. 36. IO. 3893. MD. 11830. Mithilā II. 17. MT. 3075 (with a.. C.). Oudh XI. 6. XIII. 118 (with C.). Radh. 20. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1897-1901, p. 45 (with a C. by Rājavallabha). Stein 66. Tüb. 6 (with C.). Vaṅgīya p. 187.
Edn.. (1) Haeberlin, p.. 323-347. (2) Kāvyasaṅgraha, J. Vidyāsāgara, 3rd edn. III. p.. 215-275, Calcutta. (3) With C. an. Bengali transl., Vaiṣṇava Sandarbha Series, Vol. I. Nos. 1 an. 2, 1903-07, Brindavan. (4) With C. by Sarveśvara Tarkālaṅkāra an. a Bengali transl., Mimensingh, 1880.

Uddhavapraśna
Mysore I. p. 179.

Uddhavabhaṭṭa
--Yajurvedaprātiśākhya (Ved.-paṭhanavidhi). Udaipur B. 129, 2. [Page339-b]

Uddhavamiśra
son of Himakara.
--Vaidyapradīpa. med. BORI. D. XVI. i. 275.

Uddhavasaṃvāda
Viśvabhāratī 882.

Uddhavasaṃhitā_(?)
Gough p. 168.

Uddhavasandeśa
See above Uddhavadūta.

Uddhavasandeśaprabandha
Filliozat I. 198. C.. one of the Uddhavadūtas above.

Uddhāra
name of C. by Vimala on Hemacandra's Deśīnāmamālā. See Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. I. 33.

Uddhāra
name of Tāṇḍavakṛṣṇamācārya's C. on Kheṭatantra. jy. Mysore II. p. 16.

Uddhārakośa
mantra. called also variously Kośadhyānanirṇaya, Dakṣiṇāmūrtikośa (after its a.), Bījakośoddhāra, Bījoddhārakośa, Bījākṣarakośa, Mantroddhārakośa; by Dakṣiṇāmūrti.

Uddhāradhoraṇī
archit. by Sthapati Govinda, son of Maṇḍana. Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 38.

Uddhāranātha

Uddhāranāthavākya
